SELECT d.d_moy AS month, ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt), 2) AS total_return_amt
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY d.d_moy
ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC

records.question: 2002 年 6 月的门店退货率比2001 年 6 月高多少？（用前者减去后者，结果可以为负数）保留两位小数。

rejections.reason: 表 store_returns 现在每个键有多行（状态流水）；统计前需要加过滤 sr_status = '完成'，否则会重复计算
rejections.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT d.d_year AS yr,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amt,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid_amt
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  WHERE d.d_year IN (2001, 2002) AND d.d_moy = 6
  GROUP BY d.d_year
),
rates AS (
  SELECT yr,
         return_amt / NULLIF(net_paid_amt, 0) * 100 AS rate_pct,
         return_amt, net_paid_amt
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2002 THEN rate_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2001 THEN rate_pct END), 2) AS diff_pp_raw,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2002 THEN rate_pct END), 2) - ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2001 THEN rate_pct END), 2) AS diff_pp_rounded_first,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2002 THEN rate_pct END) AS rate_2002_raw,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2001 THEN rate_pct END) AS rate_2001_raw,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2002 THEN return_amt END) AS ret_2002,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2002 THEN net_paid_amt END) AS net_2002,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2001 THEN return_amt END) AS ret_2001,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2001 THEN net_paid_amt END) AS net_2001
FROM rates
